packets.title: Pikes Peak visitor guide
packets.summary: Structured Pikes Peak guide. Tickets/permits: timed entry permit $2 per vehicle (2-hour arrival window), admission $15 per adult / $5 per child / $50 max per vehicle, cog railway from Manitou Springs from ~$58+ per adult round-trip (book ahead in summer). Driving: 19-mile highway with switchbacks, mandatory brake check halfway, allow 2-3 hours up and down. Summit: 14,115 ft, Summit Visitor Center (exhibits, restrooms, cafe, gift shop), famous altitude donuts, panoramic views. Good to know: dogs allowed, best summer through early fall, check road/train status before going.
